ask: Draft the sandbox settings and the test list for the Mac trial.
note: Repo and roadmap disagree, Oct 26: decision adoptions-declined-2026-09-28 (claude-settings 149f4bc) declines sandbox mode, because every network host and tool needs an allow entry and the guard plus deny rules give most of the gain; it reopens only on a guard bypass those miss. This step (Oct 17) plans a Mac trial anyway. Facts from Oct 17: the sandbox runs on macOS, Linux and WSL2, not native Windows, so no guard code retires; worth about an hour for real protection on the Mac; add failIfUnavailable. Proposed to triage: close unless you want the trial despite the decision.
title: Try the sandbox on your Mac
why: The OS blocks writes outside the repo however a command is spelled. Since Windows stays native (Oct 17), this protects Mac sessions only, and the guard code it would have replaced stays for Windows.
